issue_context.title: Implement OS checks
comments:
Do we want to implement them using the same underlying `RuntimeInformation` architecture?
So running `RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Create("iOS"))` would return true because it just forwards to `OperatingSystem.IsOSPlatform()`?

Ok yeah I agree it is an implementation detail but ideally the two APIs should align like in your example.

It'd be bad if in the future when we add a new platform we'd need to add it in two places or worse if `RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Create("AppleWashingMachine")` returned a different value than `OperatingSystem.IsOSPlatform("AppleWashingMachine")`
